chapters.title: Introduction to Ki Tabo and the Blessings and Curses

chapters.title: Passing on Torah Values to Children

summary: Rabbi Tobias explores parenting and education in Parashat Ki Tabo, focusing on the blessings and curses and the consequence of being sent to worship foreign gods. He discusses how failing to pass Torah values to children leads to the world raising them with opposing values.
questions: Why is being subject to foreign gods listed as a consequence of not following the Torah in Parashat Ki Tabo?
What does it mean for parents when children are raised by the values of the outside world?
How do children absorb values from their parents according to this class?
